name_reason: Follows fd2_<domain>_<descriptor> (gfx render domain). Descriptor accurately captures behaviour: render a signed (+/-) numeric modifier preceded by a sign icon. No Ghidra address residue. The 0x83/0x84 sprite indices live in the body, not the name.
purpose: Render a small "+/-NN" signed-modifier display (sign icon glyph + 2-digit magnitude in red) into a pixel buffer; used for the terrain MV-cost / DEF-bonus indicators in the tile info HUD.
logic_summary: sign_sprite_idx defaults to 0x83 (cyan '+'). If modifier < 0, switch to sprite 0x84 (red '-') and replace modifier with abs(modifier). Blit the sign icon via fd2_rle_blit_sprite from the UI/anim sprite sheet, indexing its sprite-stream offset table at sheet + *(int*)(sheet + 6 + idx*4), at dst (x=0,y=0), pitch=stride, palette op 0xFFFFFFFF. Then draw the 2-digit magnitude 8 bytes to the right (dst+8) in red (color 0x1F) via fd2_render_decimal_number_to_buffer.
signature: void __cdecl fd2_render_signed_modifier_with_icon(uint32 dst, uint32 stride, int32 modifier)

params.name: dst
params.semantics: Destination pixel-buffer linear address where the sign icon is blitted (sole caller passes panel_base + stride*8 + 0x2B for the MV indicator and panel_base + stride*0x13 + 0x2B for the DEF indicator).
params.reason: Clear, conventional destination-address name; no address residue; matches body usage as the blit/number destination base.

params.name: stride
params.semantics: Render pitch / row stride of the destination surface; forwarded unchanged to fd2_rle_blit_sprite (as pitch) and fd2_render_decimal_number_to_buffer.
params.reason: Standard stride/pitch name matching the rest of the gfx renderers in this file; no residue.

params.name: modifier
params.semantics: Signed modifier value to display (caller supplies per-tile-attr MV-cost / DEF-bonus from data_fd2_battle_tile_attr_mv_modifier_table / def_modifier_table). Sign selects the icon; magnitude (abs) is the rendered number.
params.reason: Name precisely reflects the value's role (the signed modifier being displayed); no residue; the signedness is load-bearing for the < 0 branch.

returns.semantics: No return value; side effect is the rendered sign icon + 2-digit number in the destination buffer.

notes: Sole caller fd2_render_terrain_info_hud_panel @ 0x1ACF3 invokes it twice (MV and DEF modifiers). Source comment block (rndstat.c lines 872-916) was already precise, accurate, and consistent with the Ghidra plate and decompilation; both kept unchanged. The 0x83/0x84 sprite indices and 0x1F color are domain constants (UI/anim sprite-sheet glyph indices), not address residue. The dst+8 offset table indexing (sheet+6+idx*4) matches the shared HUD sprite indexing convention. __CHK(0x20) is the compiler-injected stack-probe prologue, correctly noted as omitted in src. abs() negative-branch matches the binary's abs() CALL with EAX stored back over the modifier arg.
